title: KestrelMessage
description: A tiny, chat message formatter for Paper servers. Customize unknown commands and no permission messages without dealing with Paper configs, with clean MiniMessage styling.
body:
----------------------------------------
   A small paper message plugin
----------------------------------------

Built for servers that want their unknown and no permission command messages to be custom.  
This plugin replaces the default paper system messages with MiniMessage formatting.

No extra commands, features, or bloat. Just a small plugin to change default Paper messages.
